changelog: Sign-in rebuilt as the handoff's passwordless email flow (A_2.1 / A_2.1.1 / A_2.1.2): 'Sign up or log in' landing with a 370x68 Continue with Email card, an email step with an underlined field, and a six-cell verification-code step with a Resend countdown.
The OTP plumbing is unchanged — it still calls /user/send/email/captcha then /login/email.

Username + password moves behind a 'Sign in with password' link so existing accounts, Sign up and Forgot password stay reachable; Continue as Guest is kept for the same reason. Neither is in the handoff.
Google / Apple sign-in is out of scope for this pass, so the OR block and those two rows are not built.
